title: Digitizing death reporting in Zambia: Evaluation of a mobile-based civil registration system
why_not: The conference version of the study held as the medRxiv preprint 2025-09-12-role-of-digital-systems-in-improving-death-reporting (same authors, sites and figures); its one gap-aspect statement, the Second National Strategic Action Plan for CRVS 2021-2025, is carried by lead 5, and it dates nothing in the last twelve months.
